title: Roman numeral to integer
source: LeetCode #13 Roman to Integer — classic parsing with subtractive pairs (IV, IX, XL, ...); a standard eval item.
signature: function romanToInt(s)  // s: string (valid Roman numeral) -> integer
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `romanToInt(s)` that converts a valid Roman numeral string to its integer value. Symbols: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000. When a smaller symbol appears before a larger one it is subtracted (e.g. IV=4, IX=9, XL=40, XC=90, CD=400, CM=900).
